experiment: R1 single matched training-seed development screen
paper_writing_verdict: provisional — no paper claim audit available
what_results_support: No reference policy update occurred. Both rounds retain warm reference hashes; A=C and B=D have exact saved raw/final route and J identities and byte-identical checkpoint tensor-storage payloads.

B2 vs A2 (equivalently D2 vs C2) gain is -0.943622345550901%, CI95 [-2.4254011327888,0.6227407741918931]%; warm_nav vs warm_base is -0.7195777262135973%, CI95 [-1.8477857426736066,0.37747070700635793]%. No positive terminal-route representation benefit is supported.
All 2208 quality records have stored valid dual certificates; all required quality/timing cells are present. The main gate fails on every criterion except recorded feasibility.

D2 selects unknown actions in 124/128 training-state audits (96.875%). Those unknown choices have 0.11764425265363991% mean true advantage, 1.3349503453430234 pp optimism bias, 3.6392289194184357% mean positive regret to the queried best, and 12.444896948679288% worst such loss.

D2 mean relative degradation against native Detour16 is 9.17532445110922%, with one-sided 95% upper bound 10.598362615421696%. Cold D/Detour16 median and p95 time ratios are 1.1370509058994838 and 1.0610124545268562; hot ratios are 1.2123744742178664 and 1.0790762669689669. Native Fixed3 dominates all registered quality/time axes in both modes.

The saved journal contains 9286 started/completed terminal calls, zero failures and 6130 cache hits. Exactly 6144 optimizer steps are logged. Post-calibration elapsed time 2225.6702496 s is below 7200 s. No accounting, timing or saved-QA blocker was found.

Deployment advantage, physical feasibility/IK, seed-robust learning, untouched-test confirmation, hardware-independent speedup, or a new network gain inferred from R0 teacher search.

suggested_claim_revision: In a preregistered single-seed development screen, neither first-round candidate passed the reference-promotion rule. The second round retained the initial reference, yielding identical fixed-reference and nominal API learners within each representation. The final navigation learner failed the incremental-quality and complete quality–time deployment criteria and showed no reliable terminal-route advantage from candidate-navigation relations. These results delimit this configuration and do not establish a general failure of API or navigation information.
next_experiments_needed: None is needed to decide this frozen screen: close the configuration. Do not append updates, seeds, rounds, replacement runs or rescue ablations.

Only under a separate explicit task and newly frozen protocol: a substantively revised method must document an accepted reference change before claiming API effects, evaluate independent-state full-menu choice, and use matched multiple seeds plus an untouched test for broader claims.
A future deployment claim must satisfy full native-baseline quality–time criteria under declared hardware; this statement does not authorize future work.
